input.body:
Hello,

Re: Flat 12, 52 Meadow Row, Kingshaven, ZZ9 5ZZ – job ref R/PM014-1 (front door).

We have heard back from your landlord and are now working out the next step for the repair. In the meantime, please close the door firmly but avoid slamming it where you can, keep hands and faces away from the glass when shutting it, and let us know straight away if any glass cracks.

So we can judge how urgent this is, could you please reply to confirm: does the front door still lock securely from both inside and outside? If it ever won't lock, or the glass cracks, please call us immediately.

Kind regards
Donna
Northbridge Lettings
